Compound sentences and semicolons · 情景运用: Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。
S1; S2 two parallel clauses|S1; however, S2|a comma alone cannot join two complete sentences|therefore/thus express result|meanwhile/moreover express simultaneity or addition
